title: Mask of Soul Perception

sources.title: Detect Thoughts
markers: only the creature’s Intelligence is used

summary: Mask gives +2 to attack rolls, initiative, and Perception checks. Cast Detect Thoughts once per Short Rest.

fields.Soul Perception: +2 to attack rolls, initiative, and Perception checks.
fields.Detect Thoughts: Level 2 spell. Action on yourself, Concentration until Long Rest. During eligible dialogue, try to read a creature’s thoughts. The implementation uses an Intelligence check, and failure can make the creature hostile.
fields.Acquisition: Locked gilded chest upstairs in Helsik’s room at the Devil’s Fee, X −33, Y 20. DC 20 Sleight of Hand.
fields.Base value: 1300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
